post.summary: Kling talking-photo API — make a still portrait speak from audio or text.

400.description: Request error, it may be due to missing or invalid parameters.

401.description: Unauthorized, authorization token is invalid or missing.

500.description: Internal server error, an exception occurred on the server side.

post.description: One-click "Talking Photo": Upload a photo of a person and a piece of driving audio. The service will automatically animate the photo (image2video) and then lip-sync with the audio, ultimately returning a talking video. No need to call in two steps yourself.

mode.description: The generation quality of photo animation stage.

async.description: Return task_id immediately when true; you can poll through /kling/tasks or receive callbacks to get the result.

model.description: The Kling model used in the photo animation stage.

prompt.description: Optional: Action/expression prompts for the photo animation stage.

duration.description: Video duration (seconds), while also limiting the length of the audio reading.

audio_url.description: Public URL for audio (.mp3/.wav/.m4a/.aac, no more than 5MB), characters will lip-sync according to its content.

image_url.description: Public URL of the character photo, it is recommended to use a clear frontal photo.

callback_url.description: If provided (or async=true), it will immediately return task_id and push the result via callback when ready.
